parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "gpt-4o-mini",
  response_format: { type: "json_object" },
  temperature: 0.9,
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: "Return only valid JSON."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content:
        ($json.current_rules_prompt || "[COMPILED CURRENT RULES - ??? ?? ??]
- No current rules yet. Use strong hook, clear message, and save/share trigger.")
        + "

Convert the news article below into an Instagram-ready content draft.

Rules:
- Decide whether reel or feed is the better format.
- Make the first line stop the scroll.
- Keep the message clear within 3 seconds.
- Include a save/share trigger.
- Return JSON only.

Article Input:
ID: "
        + ($json.content_key || "")
        + "
Title: "
        + ($json.source_title || "")
        + "
Summary: "
        + ($json.source_excerpt || "")
        + "
Link: "
        + ($json.source_link || "")
        + "

Output JSON Schema:
{
  "content_type": "reel or feed",
  "topic_cluster": "health|tax|policy|comparison|debate",
  "hook_options": ["hook1","hook2","hook3","hook4","hook5"],
  "final_title": "final title",
  "body": "body draft",
  "hashtags": "#...",
  "controversy_angle": "debate angle",
  "save_cta": "save CTA",
  "comment_cta": "comment CTA",
  "music_tag": "dark_tension|urgent_news|documentary|debate",
  "image_style": "dark symbolic editorial",
  "thumbnail_hook": "thumbnail line",
  "cover_prompt": "cover image prompt",
  "reel_script": "1-second hook -> 4-second build -> key point -> save CTA",
  "scene_json": [{"scene":1,"duration":1.0,"caption":"...","image_prompt":"..."},{"scene":2,"duration":1.5,"caption":"...","image_prompt":"..."},{"scene":3,"duration":1.5,"caption":"...","image_prompt":"..."},{"scene":4,"duration":1.5,"caption":"...","image_prompt":"..."},{"scene":5,"duration":1.0,"caption":"...","image_prompt":"..."}],
  "feed_slides": ["slide1","slide2","slide3","slide4","slide5"],
  "score_hint": {"click": 0,"save": 0,"debate": 0,"info": 0,"instagram_fit": 0}
}"
    }
  ]
}) }}

{"model":"dall-e-3","size":"1024x1024","quality":"standard","response_format":"url","prompt":"Single object on dark background, cinematic lighting, high contrast, symbolic conceptual poster style, no text."}
